# Womp

> Womp is a free browser-based 3D design platform with AI-powered tools, professional printing services, and a marketplace for expert designers.

Womp combines accessible 3D modeling software with professional services including SLA printing with specialized materials like WPP and clear resin. The platform features AI tools like Primfusion for parametric modeling and maintains an active community through WompLab's early access program.

- 3D Modeling

## AI & Advanced Features

- [Primfusion](https://www.womp.com/primfusion): Primfusion AI-powered 3D conversion and parametric modeling tool
- [WompLab - Early Access to 3D Tech Experiments | Womp](https://www.womp.com/womplab): WompLab early access program for experimental 3D technologies

## 3D Printing Services

- [Professional 3D Printing with Womp](https://www.womp.com/3dprinting): Professional 3D printing service with SLA technology and WPP materials
- [White Prototyping Plastic (WPP) 3D Printing | Womp](https://www.womp.com/materials/wpp): WPP material specifications and SLA printing details for prototyping
- [Clear Resin 3D Printing | Crystal-Clear SLA Prints | Womp](https://www.womp.com/materials/clear-resin): Clear resin material specs and SLA printing process documentation
